vtt:
WEBVTT

00:00:20.000 --> 00:00:57.000
<v Dana Price>Let's look at December.</v>

00:00:57.000 --> 00:01:34.000
<v Raj Mehta>Northfield Bakery forecast is up twenty percent.</v>

00:01:34.000 --> 00:02:11.000
<v Marco Silva>Then I'll order another 10,000 kg of item TAP-2200 from Gulf Coast Starch next week.</v>

00:02:11.000 --> 00:02:48.000
<v Sam Okafor>We'll need more racking for that.</v>

00:02:48.000 --> 00:03:25.000
<v Dana Price>Sam, could you get three quotes for racking by next Friday?</v>

00:03:25.000 --> 00:04:02.000
<v Sam Okafor>Sure.</v>

00:04:02.000 --> 00:04:39.000
<v Raj Mehta>I'll confirm the December volumes with Northfield Bakery tomorrow.</v>

00:04:39.000 --> 00:05:16.000
<v Dana Price>We agreed December orders close on the 15th.</v>

00:05:16.000 --> 00:05:53.000
<v Marco Silva>There's a risk the port strike delays containers.</v>
